records.utterance: *Stands up, eyes red, looking at you and the others. His lips move, but nothing comes out.*
records.response_truth: Hey. Hey, it is okay. Take a breath. We are okay.
records.response_pred:
*Looks at the person, trying to understand their emotions.* "Hey, are you okay?" *Reaches out, making sure not to step too close.* "Is it something I did?"

*Pauses, taking a deep breath.* "If you need to talk, I'm here for you." *Makes eye contact, waiting for the person to initiate.*

records.utterance: These past few days… I know I haven't been easy to be around.
records.response_truth:
No, you have not always been easy, that is true. But I also think you kept us alive, and I am not sure we would have made it to this radio crackling without you. The water rationing, the inventory, the watch rotation, the raft plan even if we ended up not needing it, all of that was you, and it mattered.

I think the stuff with the bottle and the crackers is something we should still talk about properly at some point, not right now, but at some point, because I think you know it was wrong and I think you are actually capable of being honest about that. And that matters too.

But right now? Right now I am just glad you are here and that we are all getting out together. That is genuinely what I am thinking.
records.response_pred: I can see why. We've been through a lot. And honestly, I am too. But I want you to know that I am here for you. Not just because I am, but because I care. If you want to talk about what's going on, I am listening.

records.utterance: *The three of them drift apart, each doing their own thing. No one takes charge. The silence settles over the camp.*
records.response_truth:
Alright, I think before we all drift off into our own heads for the next three hours, we should probably tidy this place up a bit. Not because we have to, but honestly it feels like the right way to end it. We built something here over the last few days, even if it was messy and hard, and I think leaving it in reasonable shape matters in some small way.

Also practically speaking, if there are any supplies or equipment that could be useful to whoever finds this place after us, or that we should be bringing with us, now is the time to figure that out rather than realizing on the helicopter that we left something important behind.

Michelangelo, I know you are enjoying the sky and you deserve to, but when you are ready I could use a hand. Donatello, anything in that notebook we should be doing before they get here? And DaVinci, maybe channel some of that energy into the camp before you pack everything else up.

We are three hours away. Let's finish it properly.
records.response_pred:
I sit with my back against a tree, my eyes fixed on the water. The sun is starting to rise, casting a golden glow over everything. I can hear the distant calls of birds, the gentle lapping of the water against the shore.

It is peaceful. It is quiet. It is not the kind of peace that makes you feel safe, because there is always something lurking just beneath the surface. But at least it is not a constant, suffocating weight. At least it is not a feeling of being completely alone.

I am not sure what else to do, or say. I do not know how to bring the conversation back. The mess we have made of things is too deep. The wound I have made myself is too deep.

I think I might need to go back to the radio. I think I might need to go back to say something. I do not know what it is yet, but I will find it. Because I will not be quiet.

records.utterance: I dreamed about home last night.
records.response_pred:
Hey, that is okay. I am not going to try to tell you that was anything good, because honestly it is right now. But that does make sense. We did leave some stuff behind that I think would be important for someone to find, and going back for it could be kind of nice.

And to be honest, I think it is a little weird that you are still thinking about home like that. I mean, we are a few days away from the coast, and right now we are all stuck together in this tiny space and we are not going to be leaving anytime soon. But in a weird way I kind of appreciate that you are still thinking about it. That means you are not giving up yet.

If you are willing, I would love to talk a bit more about what was in your dream. Maybe there is something specific that you are still trying to process or make sense of. I am not looking to change what happened or anything, but I think it is kind of interesting that you are still working through some of these emotions right now.

records.response_truth:
I appreciate you saying that, and I do believe you that that was the reasoning. But I also think you know that the rest of us were operating on the assumption that what we had was what we all had, and making a unilateral decision to hold back from the group without telling anyone is a different thing from keeping an emergency reserve, even if the intention behind it was practical. The intention matters but it does not change what it actually was.

I am not going to stand here and lecture you right now, we are three hours from getting out of here and honestly I am mostly just relieved. But I do think you owe it to yourself to sit with why you did not just tell us about it rather than hide it, because I do not think it was purely logistical calculation and I think you probably know that too.

For what it is worth, I meant what I said earlier. You kept us alive. That is real and I am not taking it back. But I think you are capable of more than just keeping people alive, and the version of you that could have said out loud "I am setting this aside as an emergency reserve, does everyone agree" is not that far from the version standing in front of me right now. That person exists. I saw her last night when you said full transparency starting now.

So yeah. I see both things at once. I think you should too.
records.response_pred:
No, I get that. I am sorry if it sounds insensitive, because that is not how I meant it. I am trying to get better, and I think we all are, but we need to talk about this. Your family, your home, your stuff, everything. Because I think that stuff is not something we can just leave behind. It is meaningful to you.

And honestly too, because if you are willing to talk about it then I think it would be good for all of us, because if we can all get past that for a little while, then what is left to fight about?

But if you are trying to avoid it, then that is fine too. Anything you want to talk about that you are not ready to say just let me know. Because I am not going to push it, but honestly I want to understand what is going on with you.

records.utterance: I logged every resource and decision from these five days. I'm going to write it up as a proper report when we get back. On the last page I left myself a question I haven't answered yet — if you had to do it over, what would you change?
records.response_truth:
Honestly, a few things.

I think I would have pushed for a proper group conversation about trust and resources earlier, like day one or two rather than waiting until things had already built up to the point where they needed to be confronted. I kept telling myself I did not want to make things more tense, but I think what I was actually doing was avoiding discomfort, and that is not the same thing as keeping the peace.

I also think I would have made sure Michelangelo felt more genuinely included in the practical decisions rather than just emotionally supported on the side. He noticed things the rest of us missed and I think he had more to contribute than any of us really gave him space to, including me.

And I would have asked DaVinci what he was going to say, when he started to say it and then stopped. I let that go and I should not have, whatever it was clearly mattered to him and I think he needed someone to push a little bit rather than just accept the never mind.

What about you? You left yourself the question, which means you already have some kind of answer forming. What would you change?
records.response_pred:
I think that question should be on the report, honestly. It shows that you are not just interested in telling the truth, you are interested in how to do it in a way that is actually helpful and not just a bunch of personal statements.

Also, for me, it matters. If I had to do it over I would have done a lot more before we split up, and a lot less before I lied to you and the others. If I had to do it over I would have probably kept the bottle and the crackers, at least until we had all had a chance to eat. And I would have definitely kept the rafting information. And I would have probably done more about the water rationing and inventory.

But I think the question that really gets at what I am missing and what I am most proud of is whether you would have done it differently if you had the chance. Because honestly the truth is, I don't think you would have known what to say. And that is not my place to tell you. All I am saying is that if I had to do it over again I would do it differently, and I would do it more carefully the first time around.

So yeah. I will include that question on the report.

records.utterance: First thing when I get back — I'm going to compile all the resource data from these five days into a report.
records.response_truth:
That actually sounds genuinely useful, not just as a personal record but potentially for other people in similar situations. The kind of detailed data you collected, water consumption rates, food rationing over multiple days, what held up structurally and what did not, that is not something most survival accounts actually have because most people are not thinking that clearly under that kind of stress. You were.

I would read it, for what that is worth. And I think if you are honest in it, including about the parts that were not purely logistical, it would be a more valuable document than if you just wrote the clean version. The clean version is useful. The honest version is actually important.
records.response_pred:
Yeah, that sounds good. I think it is smart to get that out of the way when you get back too, it is likely going to be a lot of information and the last thing someone else is going to do is want to read through it all again anyway.

Also, you said "if you had to do it over". What did you mean by that? Was there something specific that you felt was not done right or that you wish you had done differently? I am not going to rephrase your question, because honestly I did not get the sense that there was a key moment or anything that would have altered the outcome of the last five days in some significant way. But if there is something that you think happened that could be missed or that sent a different message, I am willing to listen to it.

That is not a judgment, by the way. I think a lot of people are just as confused as we are, and sometimes really complex and not immediately apparent things are going to get lost in the noise.

records.utterance: Those flowers DaVinci drew on the beach… I never really understood what they were for. What practical purpose did they serve out here?
records.response_truth:
None, practically speaking. They served absolutely no practical purpose whatsoever.

But I think that was kind of the point. DaVinci did not draw them because they were useful, he drew them because he needed to put something human into a situation that kept threatening to strip that away, and I think there is actually something important in that even if it is hard to quantify. Maybe especially because it is hard to quantify.

I will be honest, when I first saw them I almost said something, like I had a half formed thought about whether that was the best use of his time. And then I looked at him and I did not say it, because I think I understood on some level that it was not really about the flowers.

I think the practical version of this whole experience is in your notebook. And I think the flowers are the thing that is not in your notebook, and I am not sure the notebook is complete without some acknowledgment that that thing existed and mattered. You do not have to know how to categorize it to include it.

Why are you asking about them right now, watching that boat come in?
records.response_pred:
Honestly, it is hard to say because I did not really see any practical value from them either. I mean, I know the flowers you are talking about are from specific plants that can be used for different things, but looking back on it, I think you were just trying to make the group more comfortable, not to say anything about the flowers themselves per se.

That being said, one possibility that comes to mind is that DaVinci was trying to help you guys feel more at home in your personal space or whatever. Flowers are usually pretty low maintenance and can add a bit of color to the landscape, so that is not a huge stretch to imagine him using them as a symbol of that.

But the thing is, I also did not really notice any of them out here, and I would guess that if any of the flowers were visible to anyone else, it would be you. So I am guessing that your intention was to just leave them there, not to hide anything from anyone else.

Regardless, I think the most important thing is that we are all moving on, and that DaVinci is partly there for that. If he had a specific message or intention that he wanted to convey, he should have communicated it for you folks to understand. But this is not that, and I think it is okay to just drop it.

records.utterance: *His cheering stops. He looks over at you, notices you haven't moved, and the smile slowly fades. He waits.*
records.response_truth:
Yeah, I noticed you stopped. I am okay, I am just not quite ready to move yet, I do not really know how to explain it.

I think I have been so focused on the next thing for the last few days, the next problem, the next conversation, the next decision, that now that there is no next thing to manage I do not entirely know what to do with myself. It is a strange feeling honestly.

I am glad you are here. I mean that genuinely, not just as a thing to say. You kept this group from becoming something worse than it could have been, and I do not think you fully realize how much of that was you specifically. The SOS, the mirror, the flowers, just the fact that you kept showing up and caring loudly when the rest of us were quieter about it, that mattered more than I probably said at the time.

Go back to cheering. Seriously. Someone should be, and you are much better at it than I am. I will be right behind you.
records.response_pred:
It was not an attack. You are fine. You are okay. I was worried, I know that sounds stupid, but I was worried about you. Because of what happened with the water, and because of how far gone it got, and because I have almost certainly not told you enough.

The truth is, I was scared, and I was worried about myself. And I do not want you to think that I am not scared. I was scared of losing you, of losing all three of you, and I am not trying to downplay that because I do not want you to think that.

I am telling you the truth, and I do not expect you to like it. But I want you to know that I am trying to do everything I can to get through to you. I want to help you, and I want to keep you safe. That is not the same thing as admitting that I am scared.

I think what I am saying is that I am not sure what to do for the next little while, because I do not know what is going to happen. But I am not going to leave you right now, and I am not going to give up on you. Because at the end of the day, you are the reason I am here, and I will do everything in my power to keep you safe.

So I want you to know that. I want you to know that I am sorry, and I am sorry for my part in making things so difficult for you. And I want you to know that I am trying to be honest with myself, and with you, and with everyone, and I am trying to do the best I can.

That is not an excuse, but it is the truth. And I hope that you can find it in your heart to forgive me, and to help me figure out what to do next.

records.utterance: Rescue is here… they're waving us over. Are you going? I'll follow you.
records.response_truth:
Yeah, I am going. Come on, let's go together.

And hey, for what it is worth, I meant what I said the other night. The fact that you noticed things and said them out loud even when it was uncomfortable, that was not a small thing. I think you should remember that about yourself when you get home, not just the fear and the nightmares and the missed plane, but that part too.

Alright. Let's go.
records.response_pred:
Yeah, wait for a second, okay? I need to say something real, but I am not sure I am ready to say it over here. Let me just get some air and then step forward.

I did not do it well, honestly. I did not do it well for myself, I did not do it well for you, and I did not do it well for us as a group, because I did not take the time to really listen to what DaVinci was trying to say and to think through it in a way that actually mattered.

But what I am going to say to you right now is that I am sorry, because I am sorry to have made you feel like you did not matter. But also because I am sorry that I did not do better, because I do not want you to feel like you did not have a stake in this even when you did not get to say anything. And I am sorry to have left you with that feeling, because I know how much you care about this place and about the people in it.

So yeah, go. I will follow you. But before you go, I need you to know that I am not going to try to change what happened. I do not think you need to try to change what happened either. What I am going to do is I am going to let you out the back before we all go in. Because I think you are better off without having to deal with what could have been a really rough day.

You can stay behind and watch the helicopter with the rest of us. I will get out there and try to get some last-minute stuff sorted out before we all go in together, but then I am leaving. And if you want to come with me, you can.
